title: Sum of the first n integers, by induction
prose: Theorem. For all natural numbers n, the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n equals n(n+1)/2. Proof. For n = 1 both sides equal 1. Assume the claim holds for n. Then the sum up to n+1 equals n(n+1)/2 plus (n+1), which equals (n+1)(n+2)/2, completing the induction.
